cost_and_execution_assumptions: Signal from bars strictly before the entry bar: opening return uses bars 0-1 (09:30-09:31), entry at the open of bar 2 (09:32), exit at the last regular-session bar close, same day. Cost per side 10 bp (primary), 20 bp (stress), and the original draft's 0.5 bp commission + 2 bp slippage as a reference, applied as entry*(1+c) and exit*(1-c) exactly as _symbol_intraday_return does. Short trades also pay 0.5 percent a year borrow (about 0.2 bp per day; Alpaca charges $0 on easy-to-borrow names, the charge is conservative). One position per day at 100 percent of capital, zero on no-signal days, no leverage, no overnight.
stop_condition: Stop (refuted) if R0 anchor Sharpe at 10 bp < 1.19 or 20 bp anchor CAGR <= 0 (K1). Partial if K1 passes but K2 (combo edge with S3 >= +0.05) or G3 (beats >= 90 percent of 200 random placebos) fails. Kept only if K1, K2 and G3 all pass. Thresholds are frozen here and in candidate-manifest.json; nothing is relaxed after results.

sources.claim: We also show that short-term return reversal is driven by temporary liquidity imbalances lasting less than an hour and bid-ask bounce.
sources.applicability: Mechanism prior for buying an opening loser: reversal from transient liquidity imbalance that decays within about an hour; the route enters 2 minutes after the open and holds to the close, so the effect window and the holding window differ.
sources.limitations: arXiv abstract page snapshot (tag-stripped text), not full paper; TAQ sample ends 2003, pre-decimal-penny and pre-Reg-NMS-era microstructure.
sources.independent_replication: Short-term reversal as liquidity-provision compensation is corroborated by Kang, Lin, Xiong (JEDC 2022) and the intraday-loser buying pressure in Baltussen, Da, Soebhag (2025); not re-derived locally.

sources.claim: Individual stocks experience sharp intraday return reversals in the cross-section during the last 30 minutes of the trading day.
sources.market_and_period: U.S. individual stocks, intraday, last 30 minutes of the session (sample per paper)
sources.applicability: Recent (2025) evidence that intraday losers get positive price pressure in the cross-section of U.S. stocks; our route holds the opening loser through that late-day window.
sources.limitations: Working paper (April 2025); documents reversal in the last 30 minutes, not the first minutes after the open; effect attributed to retail attention and short-seller risk management.
sources.independent_replication: Single working paper; the intraday reversal literature (Heston et al. 2010; Kang et al. 2022) is consistent but covers different windows.

sources.claim: Eleven families fail because gross return before friction is 0.07-1.50 points, below the 2.0-point friction floor.
sources.market_and_period: Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures, 947 sessions of 5-minute data 2021-2025, expanding-window walk-forward, 14 OHLCV intraday signal families
sources.applicability: Negative prior: opening-window OHLCV rules on Nasdaq-100 products usually fail the friction and year-stability tests, so a pass here needs to survive both explicitly.
sources.limitations: Futures, not single stocks; single-author arXiv preprint (v3 2026-09-15); OHLCV signals only. Its gap-continuation short and VVG reversal both failed year stability.
sources.independent_replication: Independent negative evidence that most OHLCV-only intraday rules do not survive friction and year-stability; no replication found yet.

sources.claim: Previous studies of the U.S. market regard short-term reversal as compensation for liquidity provision.
sources.market_and_period: Chinese A-share intraday reversal (paper's own sample); the sentence quoted summarizes U.S. literature
sources.applicability: Frames why a reversal premium can be earned by liquidity providers and is expected to shrink with spread and with tape coverage.
sources.limitations: Chinese-market evidence; abstract-level snapshot; proposes liquidity oversupply by uninformed providers, not a U.S. result.
sources.independent_replication: Consistent with Heston et al. (2010) for the U.S. liquidity-provision reading; the Chinese-market mechanism differs.

sources.claim: we dissect their returns into intraday and overnight com- ponents with respect to the U.S. market hours
sources.market_and_period: Asian ADRs vs SPY, intraday vs overnight return decomposition
sources.applicability: Supports evaluating the route as a pure intraday (open-to-close) return stream separate from overnight gaps, as the router does.
sources.limitations: ADR pairs setting, not a single-stock reversal test; used only for the overnight/intraday return decomposition convention.
